title: Spa Filter Maintenance Filter Pressure Leaderboard
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:filter pressure_psi=*
| stats sum(pressure_psi) as total_value, avg(pressure_psi) as avg_value by filter_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks filter values by total and average filter pressure across spa filter maintenance events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `pressure_psi` values for each spa filter maintenance event and review total and average filter pressure by filter.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total filter pressure.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which filter shows the biggest filter pressure numbers in your spa filter maintenance data.
